phase_definition: Family F1: original C/PEEK transverse carbon-fiber microscopy cross-section. Output labels0=PEEK matrix,1=carbon-fiber cross-sections,2=void. Matrix and fiber are solids; void is distinct. Preserve all three labels. Model cross-sectional packing and small approximately circular fiber sections, not longitudinal lines or an in-plane fiber-axis orientation. Evaluator fiber annotations approximate detected centers with mean-radius circles; touching circles can merge into annotation regions. Void annotations also have segmentation uncertainty. Physical micrometers per pixel are unknown.
